presets.name: Three Rivers Loop
presets.note: The whole loop: the Point, downtown, the South Side and the McArdle climb to Grandview

presets.name: Three Rivers Loop · reverse
presets.note: The loop the other way: over the West End Bridge, Grandview and down McArdle first

presets.name: South Side Short Loop
presets.note: Skips the South Side riverfront: right at East Carson & 10th, straight up McArdle

presets.name: South Side Short Loop · reverse
presets.note: Grandview and down McArdle, then left at East Carson & 10th back to downtown

presets.name: South Side Flat Loop
presets.note: East Carson Street and the river trail, round and round from East Carson & 10th

presets.name: Three Rivers Loop + West End Overlook
presets.note: The whole loop with the climb through Elliott to the West End Overlook and back down

presets.name: Jail Trail & South Side Loop
presets.note: From downtown along the Jail Trail, over the Hot Metal Bridge and back on the South Side river trail

presets.name: Point & Jail Trail Loop
presets.note: The Point and downtown, the Jail Trail, the Hot Metal Bridge and the river trail, back by the Smithfield Street Bridge

presets.name: Jail Trail & Mount Washington Loop
presets.note: The flat Jail Trail out, the river trail, then the McArdle climb and Grandview home

presets.name: Mount Washington There & Back
presets.note: Up McArdle, along Grandview to the Water Steps, then back over the top

presets.name: Three Rivers There & Back
presets.note: The whole loop, then the whole loop backwards

presets.name: Schenley Park Loop
presets.note: Round Schenley Park from Phipps: Schenley Drive, Serpentine Drive, the Oval and up Panther Hollow

presets.name: Jail Trail, Oakland & Schenley
presets.note: The Jail Trail, up Junction Hollow to Oakland and the Cathedral of Learning, round Schenley Park and back down to downtown

presets.name: Oakland & South Side Loop
presets.note: The Point, the Jail Trail, Oakland and Schenley Park, then over the Hot Metal Bridge and home on the river trail

presets.name: Allegheny Loop
presets.note: From the Water Steps along the North Shore Trail to Millvale, over the 40th Street Bridge, down Butler Street and through the Strip, home over the Clemente Bridge

presets.name: Allegheny Loop · reverse
presets.note: Over the Clemente Bridge, up Penn Avenue and Smallman Street through the Strip and Lawrenceville, back along the river from Millvale

presets.name: Allegheny & Jail Trail Loop
presets.note: Both rivers on the flat: the Allegheny Loop, the Point, the Jail Trail, the Hot Metal Bridge and the South Side river trail

presets.name: Troy Hill Climb Loop
presets.note: From the 16th Street Bridge along the river to the 31st Street Bridge, straight up Rialto Street (Pig Hill, about 24 %), over Troy Hill and back down Troy Hill Road

presets.name: Water Steps & Troy Hill
presets.note: Out along the North Shore Trail, up Rialto Street to Troy Hill and down Troy Hill Road, back past PNC Park to the Water Steps

presets.name: Allegheny Loop + Troy Hill
presets.note: The Allegheny Loop with a lap of Troy Hill: up Rialto Street at the 31st Street Bridge, down Troy Hill Road, then on to Millvale, Lawrenceville and the Strip

presets.name: Polish Hill Climb Loop
presets.note: From Liberty Ave over the 28th Street Bridge, up Brereton St past Immaculate Heart of Mary and Dobson St, down Herron Avenue's hairpin and back along Liberty

presets.name: Polish Hill, Bloomfield & Oakland Loop
presets.note: From the Strip up through Polish Hill, over the Bloomfield Bridge, through Bloomfield and across to Schenley Plaza; down Junction Hollow, the Jail Trail into downtown and Penn Avenue back to the Strip

presets.name: Allegheny, Polish Hill & Oakland Loop
presets.note: The North Shore Trail to Millvale and Lawrenceville, up through Polish Hill and Bloomfield to Oakland, down Junction Hollow and the Jail Trail, home over the Clemente Bridge

presets.name: Great Allegheny Passage to Homestead
presets.note: From SouthSide Works out the GAP along the Mon to the Waterfront, a lap of Homestead past the Pump House and Eighth Avenue, and back

presets.name: Jail Trail & the GAP to Homestead
presets.note: The Point, the Jail Trail and the Hot Metal Bridge, the GAP to Homestead and a lap past the Pump House, home on the South Side river trail

presets.name: North Side Hills Loop
presets.note: From the Water Steps: the National Aviary, Randyland, the Fineview climb and overlook, Riverview Park and the Allegheny Observatory, the Davis Avenue Bridge and down Brighton Road

presets.name: North Side Hills Loop · reverse
presets.note: Up Brighton Road to Riverview Park and the Observatory first, then down through Fineview past the overlook, Randyland and the Aviary

presets.name: Fineview Climb Loop
presets.note: From the Water Steps past the Aviary and Randyland, up Belleau Street to the Fineview Overlook, down Perrysville Avenue's bends and back

presets.name: Three Rivers & North Side Loop
presets.note: The Three Rivers Loop with McArdle and Grandview, over the West End Bridge, up Brighton Road to Riverview Park, down through Fineview, Randyland and the Aviary to the Water Steps

presets.name: Sycamore Street & Grandview
presets.note: From Station Square straight up Sycamore Street (a Dirty Dozen climb) to Mount Washington, over Wyoming St's cobbles to Grandview past the Monongahela Incline, down McArdle and back along East Carson

presets.name: South Side Slopes Climb Loop
presets.note: From East Carson & 27th up the Slopes' Dirty Dozen streets (Barry, Holt and Eleanor), along Arlington's ridge to Allentown, over Bailey Ave to Mount Washington, down Sycamore Street to Station Square and East Carson home

presets.name: Dirty Dozen South Loop
presets.note: Up Sycamore Street from Station Square, across Mount Washington and down to Beechview for Boustead Street and Canton Avenue's cobbles (about 37 %), up Warrington Ave to Allentown, along Arlington's ridge and down the South Side Slopes to East Carson

presets.name: Dirty Dozen South from the Slopes
presets.note: From East Carson & 27th up Barry, Holt and Eleanor to Allentown, over to Mount Washington and down to Beechview for Boustead Street and Canton Avenue's cobbles, back up Warrington Ave and down the Slopes

freeRide.name: Free Ride · choose every turn
freeRide.note: No plan: from the Water Steps, straight on at every junction unless you choose a turn. Ride until you stop
